faq_heading: Homes near Strawberry Hill Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Strawberry Hill Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Strawberry Hill Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Strawberry Hill Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Strawberry Hill Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Westerman Elementary (0.4 km west), Dr F D Sinclair Elementary (0.9 km east) and Jarvis Traditional Elementary (1.1 km west).

How the Strawberry Hill Elementary search works

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Strawberry Hill Elementary

32 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Strawberry Hill Elementary in a straight line (22 elementary, 7 secondary, 3 other; 6 independent). The closest is Westerman Elementary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Continuing Ed SD36 (Invergarry), 2.4 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Princess Margaret Secondary (1.4 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa School Newton (1.3 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Chalmers Elementary (2.2 km). Other elementary schools close by: Westerman Elementary (0.4 km west), Dr F D Sinclair Elementary (0.9 km east), Jarvis Traditional Elementary (1.1 km west), Cougar Creek Elementary (1.2 km south), Khalsa School Newton (1.3 km south). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Westerman Elementary, 0.4 km west of Strawberry Hill Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Strawberry Hill Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Strawberry Hill Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Strawberry Hill Elementary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.
Look at Westerman Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.4 km west of Strawberry Hill Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
